name: Tide Slideshow
description: A full-bleed slideshow where each image washes in over the last like a tide, with content laid over the top.

props.name: images
props.description: The slides, in order. A string is an image URL with no alt text, for images that are only backdrop.

props.name: children
props.description: Content laid over every slide, placed at the bottom left above the controls.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Move on by itself. It holds while hovered or focused, has a pause button, and is off under reduced motion.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds each slide stays before the next washes in. The current hairline fills over this time.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the edge of the incoming image travels.

props.name: overlay
props.description: A dark fade from the bottom for legibility. Content over it is set in the night palette so light text reads.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the content layer, for example to centre it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the slideshow for assistive technology.

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: string; next?: string; pause?: string; play?: string; goTo?: (index) => string; slide?: (index, count) => string }
props.description: Text for assistive technology, for translation.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root, which takes its height from you. Also accepts every other prop of a section.
